hero.label: Our Support Architectures
hero.description: Three levels of support, precisely calibrated to match the realities and ambitions of every excellence profile.

targets.title: Strategic Category
targets.subtitle: Leaders · Executive Committee · Shareholders · Partners
targets.reality: Ultra-critical time, intertwined professional and personal life, maximum exposure to operational distractions. Every lost hour is a abandoned strategic decision.
targets.offer: Unique Senior Contact, 24/7 · 365 days/year availability, unlimited support (family, professional, diplomatic, asset management).
targets.gain: Total mental liberation. You no longer manage anything — you decide. You no longer coordinate — you lead.

targets.title: Operational Category
targets.subtitle: Senior Executives · Managers · High-level Experts
targets.reality: Constant mobility, on-the-ground emergency management, need for immediate responsiveness. Performance is hindered by logistical friction, not by skills.
targets.offer: Priority assistance 6am–10pm, 7/7 — complete travel management, urgent administrative support, routine personal tasks, dedicated hotline.
targets.gain: Absolute fluidity of movement. Regain up to 15 hours of productivity per week, reinvested in your professional excellence.

targets.title: Talent Category
targets.subtitle: Executives · Strategic Employees · Exceptional Young Talents
targets.reality: Maximum ambition, but held back by time-consuming daily tasks — errands, admin, personal organization. The potential is there. The time is missing.
targets.offer: Premium essential services on business days 8am–8pm: errands, dry cleaning, routine admin, personal organization, dedicated digital platform.
targets.gain: Total focus on skill development and value creation. Increased retention of top profiles within your organization.
